banquet-check-file.name: Banquet Check File
banquet-check-file.description: Compare banquet-check PDFs to matching BEOs for menu, counts, extras, service charge, and tax.

beo-pack.name: BEO Pack
beo-pack.description: Assemble BEO pages for definite functions and attach menu prices only as printed on their menu file.

coi-missing.name: COI Missing
coi-missing.description: From definite events, list renter or required vendor COIs that are present, expired, missing wording, or missing event dates.

cutoff-list.name: Cutoff List
cutoff-list.description: From the hold sheet, list tentative options with cutoff on or before the pack date, plus blank cutoff cells as asks.

diagram-revision-log.name: Diagram Revision Log
diagram-revision-log.description: List diagram PDFs by event, date, and revision label. Mark the latest dated file and any undated overwrite.

group-pickup-if-any.name: Group Pickup If Any
group-pickup-if-any.description: If a sleeping-room block file exists, list contracted rooms, pickup, remaining, printed rate, and room cutoff.

guarantee-vs-setup.name: Guarantee vs Setup
guarantee-vs-setup.description: Compare the guarantee or labeled expected count on each BEO to chair and table counts on the dated diagram.

hold-vs-definite.name: Hold vs Definite
hold-vs-definite.description: Build one list of tentative holds and definite bookings for the same date range. Keep status as they coded it.

load-in-calendar.name: Load-In Calendar
load-in-calendar.description: Build a dock, elevator, and vendor arrival calendar from the timeline sheet and BEO time blocks.
